headline: ALL DIPLOMATIC PATHS COLLAPSE: DEFCON 1 DECLARED AMID STRAIT THEATER BUILDUP
sub_chyron: AI reports intense naval activity in Strait Theater; UNSC summit fails as DEFCON 1 is raised globally. Command Bunker warns of imminent escalation.
anchor_voice_script: We are live with breaking news from the Command Bunker: Diplomatic efforts have catastrophically failed. DEFCON 1 has been declared worldwide amidst a rapidly escalating crisis in the Strait Theater.
veo_visual_prompt: Cinematic shot of a naval fleet maneuvering under missile fire in a narrow strait, with fighter jets streaking across the sky.
